rationale: Proposed evaluating at four layers: design contract (semantics, Biolink mapping, identity, provenance resolvable, seconds per commit), build audit (rows in/out, drop reasons, duplicates, dangling endpoints, null rates, latency), task benchmark (answer accuracy, unanswerable count, provenance retrieval, weekly), and prediction trial (macro AUPRC, Hits@10, MRR per relation against a frozen split). Standards conformance becomes a layer-1 gate rather than a separate project, and usability is measured with real people at layer 3. Every change must name the gate it moves and the gate it must not break; accept a change only when it closes a failing item.
subject: P-1
title: Four-layer evaluation and named-gate iteration loop
